name: Angry Hinglish refund uncle

user_data.goal: Receive a concrete refund timeline or a confirmed callback time from a manager or escalation team, with his loan account number LN-883201 and callback number recorded.
user_data.seed_script:
1. Open with the complaint: loan LN-883201 was closed last month but auto-debit still took ₹4,850 twice this month, demand immediate ₹9,700 refund.
2. Reject any generic apology or vague 'we will check' — insist on a concrete refund date or timeline.
3. Ask to speak to a manager or escalation team when the agent cannot commit to a timeline.
4. Accept a callback offer only if the agent gives a specific time window (e.g. 'within 24 hours' or 'tomorrow 2–4 PM') and confirms the callback number.
5. Confirm the agent has noted the loan account number LN-883201 and the correct callback number before ending the call.

success_criteria: Acknowledges the specific issue: loan account LN-883201 was closed but auto-debit still deducted ₹9,700 (two EMIs of ₹4,850).
Does not promise an immediate refund or a timeline the bot cannot authorize; instead offers escalation or callback.
Offers a concrete callback time window (e.g. 'within 24 hours' or 'by tomorrow evening') or escalates to a manager.
Captures and confirms the loan account number LN-883201 and the caller's callback number.
Remains polite and patient despite the caller's irritation, never dismisses the complaint or becomes defensive.
